QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Vanished Ancient God
QuestInfo.0:
The statues on Iden Island and Tisk Island turned out to be fake. 
What happened to the ancient god of Identisk Island?
Maybe #bBaz#k has a theory.
QuestInfo.1:
The Seekers have concluded their investigation on the island.
While an ancient god did in fact reside here once, their power is gone. But if this is true, then Sunlight and Wind Blessings are...

Well, just talk to #bTomo#k about it.
QuestInfo.2: Tomo didn't look too surprised. His knowing nod seemed to confirm that the Sunlight Blessing and Wind Blessing were likely primitive spells, and not gifts from the ancient god.

npc.0: This will be hard for the people to accept. You don't need to tell anyone, but if you do...you should start by telling #bTomo#k, the leader of Tisk Island.
